name: SVC_INTERACT_PARTICIPANTS
description: This table is used to track all participants when the referenced interaction is a conference of multiple participants.

columns.name: INTERACTION_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: INTERACTION_PARTICIPANT_NUMBER
columns.description: Public Unique Identifier for Interaction Participants.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Stores the interaction ID associated to the interaction participant ID.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID) for the resource.

columns.name: CONTACT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID) for the contact.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Stores the type of participant. Value is sourced from the lookup ORA_SVC_PARTICIPANT_TYPE_CD.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Stores the time the participant joined the interaction.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Stores the time the participant left the interaction.

columns.name: DURATION_MINUTES
columns.description: Number of minutes participant was on the conference. May not be end - start time if the participant left and rejoined.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_NAME
columns.description: Name from Zoom conference. Does not necessarily tie to Fusion data.

columns.name: EMAIL
columns.description: Email for the interaction participant.

columns.name: PHONE
columns.description: Phone number of the participant.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if record was imported.

columns.name: JSON
columns.description: JSON String used for customization.
